proposed_text: 领土；地域，指边界或明确或不明确的一片土地。
accepted_text: 地域；边界或明确或不明确的一片土地。
review_reason: 地域 retains the general land-area sense. Removing 领土 avoids the unselected implication of sovereign national territory; the boundary explanation stays intact.

proposed_text: 奶奶；外婆，亲昵、口语或儿童用语中的“祖母”。
accepted_text: 奶奶；外婆，亲昵、口语或儿童用语中的“祖母或外祖母”。
review_reason: 奶奶/外婆 and 祖母或外祖母 explicitly cover either side of the family, while retaining the affectionate, colloquial or childish register. The proposal's final 祖母 alone excluded the maternal side.
reviewer: Independent reviewer #137, codex/d2-review-137; separate from content author and integration coordinator
